title: Grantha Envelope Schema
description: Top-level envelope for a grantha. Carries identity, classification, and an ordered list of edition stubs. One file per grantha.

kind.description: Explicit file-type discriminator. Must be 'grantha-envelope' for top-level grantha envelopes.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema in semver format (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH). Major version changes indicate breaking schema changes.

edition_stub.description: Lightweight descriptor for one edition. Carried in the grantha envelope's editions array. A .json suffix in path means single file; no suffix means directory.

path.description: Relative path to the edition file or directory. A .json suffix = single file; no suffix = directory containing an envelope + part files.

commentary_of.description: Parent commentary_id this edition comments on. Omitted for direct commentaries on the mula.

isDefault.description: Mark exactly one edition stub as default in a multi-edition grantha. Moot for single-edition granthas.

edition_sub_envelope.description: Shape of the envelope.json that lives inside an edition directory for multi-part editions. Validated by the Python validator using this definition.

kind.description: Explicit file-type discriminator. Must be 'edition-sub-envelope' for edition-directory envelopes.

parts.description: Ordered list of content parts for this edition. Each entry names the file and records the ref of the first main passage in that file, so the runtime knows which structural group (e.g. Adhyaya) the part belongs to without loading the content file.

file.description: Filename of the part content file.

first_ref.description: Ref of the first main passage in this part file (e.g. '3.1.1'). The top-level segment (split on '.') identifies the structural group this part belongs to.

structure_level.description: One level in the hierarchical structure of a grantha (e.g. Adhyaya, Brahmana, Mantra). Canonical definition lives here; grantha.schema.json references this.

oneOf.description: Array of child structure levels (preferred format)
Single child structure level (legacy format - will be converted to array)
